title: Chargeback Evidence Dossier
description: Output schema for the chargeback-evidence-builder pipeline. Validated by the schema_validate node before returning to the backend.

dispute_id.description: The dispute identifier passed in from the bank

confidence_score.description: 0-100 score derived from how many signals are favorable

confidence_label.description: Short plain-language label for the score, e.g. 'strong case', 'weak evidence'

evidence_letter.description: Formal evidence letter addressed to the payment processor's dispute team

missing_evidence.description: List of evidence items that could not be gathered. Empty array if all evidence collected.
